title: Execution-owned Unit Summary Read Contract v1
description: Read only direct .fgos/assignments/unit-run-*/unit-summary.json files, at most 1 MiB each. Never recurse into unit directories or read results, workflow events, transcripts, protected data or outboxes. Skip symlink state roots, unit directories and summary files; skip malformed/unsupported records and summaries without owner-owned RFC3339 settledAt. unitRunId must equal the directory name. Compare timestamp windows temporally in UTC milliseconds with inclusive bounds, never lexicographically; bounds accept RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD (UTC midnight), and invalid/reversed bounds are named errors. Emit source unit-summary, kind unit.settled, subject kind run with id unit-run:<unitRunId>. This distinct kind does not increase run.settled totals. Outcome and final selection are owned by the Node writer using unit-run-history; Rust never derives or selects attempts.

outcome.description: Opaque execution-owned unit outcome. pass counts as a passing unit; other values remain visible.

startedAt.description: Unit creation time, used only for duration; never a substitute for settlement.

settledAt.description: Required owner settlement time; historical null timestamps are skipped, never creation-derived.

runId.description: null only for an inline unit result, which is a seat but not a dispatch attempt in metrics totals.

outcome.description: Owner vocabulary: pass, findings, blocked, policy-refusal, provider-limit or execution-failure.

fallbackFrom.description: Original execution-owner fallback provenance object, preserved unchanged; repeated/resumed runs without fallback provenance do not count as fallback seats.

stance.description: Tolerant writer extraction from the settled result agentClaim. No report or transcript scanning. Confidence is unweighted. Voting roles are exactly panelist or panelist-N; synthesizers/other roles do not vote. With declared options and voting seats, largest valid choice group divided by all final voting seats gives agreement; genuineSplit is largest*3 < seats*2. Missing/invalid remain explicit and in the denominator. No options or no voting seats is unmeasured.

choice.description: A declared option or other; an out-of-set choice is invalid, never a group.
